items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They have a densha [train] from Shibuya station to, on the way to Yokohama.

ctx.x: Yes, Setagaya-ku [ward], yes. Setagaya-ku is a more residential area. They have a densha [train] from Shibuya station to, on the way to Yokohama.

They had a house, so I had one room upstairs they rented to me. So, those days … later, yeah, I also left there and went to other places. But it‟s always, those days I was always renting one room or the upstairs. Later on, before, maybe a year before I came to this country, I was in Shinagawa, and upstairs.… See, in those days, after the war was ended, many, relatively wealthy people lost income, so they rented out rooms for the income. So there was quite a lot of those, y‟know. And, uh, the last one I had, they…
